scope: Exploratory fixed-split supplementary checks; original four-attribute score unchanged
annual_control: 384 annual midpoint quantiles of log1p(Q/mean Q), valid nonnegative flows 1981-2010; no FDC mixture, as for annual 32/128 controls
seasonal_targets: Circular concentration of climatological monthly-mean flow expanded uniformly over nonleap calendar days
Parde amplitude: (max monthly mean flow - min monthly mean flow) / mean of 12 monthly means
prediction: 10-nearest-donor median; raw MAE separately, no combined seasonal score
weights: Primary calibrated FDC weights retained: monthly=0, FDC+allocation=0.25, OT+FDC=0.25; FDC and geographic unmixed
uncertainty: 5000 physical-station cluster bootstrap paired MAE differences, seed 2026091751; individual intervals
interpretation: Same-period discharge-derived outcomes; representation alignment, not independent external validation
